name: Run Configurations
description: Runs your applications as an IDE does: Tomcat, Java applications and JARs, Maven, Gradle, npm scripts (Vue, React, Angular…) and any command, with their output in a Run panel. The configurations are kept in the folder (.kalem/run.json), to share with the team. Tomcat is set up as in IntelliJ IDEA: the WAR and exploded artifacts of the folder's Maven and Gradle modules are found and built before launch, several deployed each at its own context.
